system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: Lucy Park's account was used to create tmp.rwong, and the same logon session added the account to the Temp-Staff group. This matches the documented temporary-account naming and group practice.
The provided account-creation and group-membership records show tmp.rwong added to Temp-Staff; they do not show administrator-group membership.
Lucy Park launched cmd.exe and then OpenSSH ssh.exe, targeting PROXY-HD-01 from WS-LPARK-01.

The SSH client resolved PROXY-HD-01 to 10.30.20.30 and initiated a TCP connection to port 22. The environment states remote administration is only done from WS-OHADDAD-01, so this activity is inconsistent with the documented practice, but the records do not establish whether SSH authentication succeeded.

Edge on WS-LPARK-01 also initiated a TCP connection to the proxy on port 8080, consistent with the organization's explicit web-proxy setup; the available records do not establish what web activity occurred.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs for PROXY-HD-01 were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC due to a collection outage; this overlaps the account creation and observed connections. This limitation comes from the supplied sensor-status data, which has no record ID.
The provided records show the SSH client connection attempt but do not include SSH server-side authentication or session records.
claims_not_established: Whether tmp.rwong was created under an approved help-desk request.
Whether the SSH connection authenticated, opened a session, or executed commands.
Whether Lucy Park's workstation or credentials were compromised.
Whether tmp.rwong was later used or received group memberships or privileges not shown in the provided records.
What web requests or other proxy activity occurred during the proxy-log collection outage.
additional_evidence_needed: SSH authentication and session logs from PROXY-HD-01 for the review window.
The help-desk ticket or approval associated with creating tmp.rwong, and a review of the account's current group memberships and activity.
Proxy logs or equivalent retained request data for 13:30–14:10 UTC.
Endpoint investigation of WS-LPARK-01 and relevant authentication records to determine whether the SSH activity was authorized or resulted from compromise.
